physical_grid_definition: Published marginal medians and plus/minus three quoted uncertainties: m=0.78+/-0.04 solar masses, |cos i|=0.176+/-0.011. Cartesian stress scenarios, not joint posterior or confidence region. Third-and-higher exact Shapiro harmonics at the preserved native phase; original apparent orbit retained.
scope: One finite comparison of omitted, literature-constrained physical Shapiro, and flexible orbital harmonics; noise reselected for each. Conditional residual harmonic checks and synthetic information-loss checks only. No observed outer-period scan, threshold calibration, automatic model promotion or expansion beyond this grid.
readiness: Require supported interior noise solution, no unresolved orbital-structure diagnostic at the existing nominal p<0.0027 criterion, and local orbital shifts within the checked three-sigma domain. Free harmonic treatment also needs a separately specified calibrated uncertainty/sensitivity route; raw objective improvement alone never qualifies it. Boundary/ambiguity retains hold.
